BU Astronomy Department
Astronomy encompasses all aspects of the physical universe, from the upper atmosphere of the Earth to the edge of the cosmos. Excitement, curiosity, innovation, and new findings fill our courses and inspire our research. We use modeling, numerical simulations, telescopic and in-situ observatories to reveal what is hidden out there.
